main.description: Get a single record from a permissioned space. This is a boundary-scoped read of a record this service holds. It is a Stratos method, not the upstream com.atproto.space.getRecord of a similar name, and a member's own PDS is never asked. It is callable with standard user auth (the caller must be a member of the space) or with a space credential for that space (for syncing services). The record must belong to the requested space; records outside it - including records with no space at all - resolve to RecordNotFound (no existence leak).

space.description: The space's URI (at:space/{did}/{type}/{skey}). This is a space URI in the form above; upstream's space-ref format (atproto#5187) is expected to adopt it. Declared as a plain string until @atproto/lexicon supports a matching format. Its space DID must equal this service's DID.

repo.description: The DID of the account whose repo to read from.

collection.description: The NSID of the record collection.

errors.name: RecordNotFound
errors.description: The record does not exist in the requested space (or does not exist at all - indistinguishable by design).

errors.name: UnknownSpace
errors.description: The requested space URI is malformed or its space DID does not match this service's DID.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: The caller is not admitted to the requested space (not a member, or the presented credential targets a different space).
